verdict.rationale: Sardine's Case Management is marketed as a unified workspace to review alerts and conduct investigations. Its sanctions screening auto-clears low-risk matches and escalates or routes higher-risk ones with explainable scores, which is a form of alert prioritization. Grouping subjects and transactions into a single investigation is not documented, and the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: documented ability to link or group multiple subjects and transactions into one investigation, analyst-controlled alert prioritization or queueing in case management, in-depth docs and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
AI agents clear obvious false positives, perform supporting research, and route higher-risk matches for analyst review.
Auto-clear low-risk matches and escalate real exposure with explainable scores.
